author: kycrafft
body:
Players: 8-16
Object of the game: Get 20 kills first

Players in this FFA game will fight each other with insta-kill weapons. However, every 10 seconds, players will get blindness 1, speed 1, and strenght 10  for 10 seconds. This is a blackout, during which players will get double points for kills. No natural regen!

Basic kit: Iron sword (3 shot-kill), bow (3 shot-kill) and 7 arrows, 2 gapples +  leather armor

Level 25 kit: iron sword (3 shot-kill), bow (3 shot-kill), speed 1 and 10 arrows 1 gapple + chain armor

Donator kit:  iron sword (3 shot-kill), bow (3 shot-kill), 5 arrows, 2 enderpearls, 1 gapple+ gold armor

Suggestions please, and should I keep the insta-kill?
